answer: Registration also requires burning a cedar token whose cost scales with cluster size, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded bridge: each agent must lock a stake behind a unique human-attested identity, and every new identity passes through a prism that splits reputation from raw address count, so cloned keys earn nothing. Attackers must pay compounding stake plus token burn per clone, while honest agents recover their bond on exit. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
